summary: Dynex Capital filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement for an offering of a new Series D Fixed-Rate Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock with a $25.00 per-share liquidation preference. Dividends accrue at a fixed rate (blank in the preliminary filing) payable quarterly beginning January 15, 2027. Shares are callable at $25.00 plus accrued dividends on or after October 15, 2031, with a Change-of-Control conversion right subject to a Share Cap. Deal size, gross proceeds, pricing spread, and underwriters are not yet stated; watch for final terms and use of proceeds.
